faq.question: What's the difference between a CODAKIS subscription and driving school plans?
faq.answer: Free or Premium subscriptions cover theory preparation on CODAKIS only (10 CEMAC topics, quizzes, mock exams). Theory-only, driving-only or full packages are sold by MINT-approved partner driving schools, with Mobile Money payment and a QR enrolment receipt.

faq.question: How do I buy a driving package?
faq.answer: From a partner driving school profile, choose a plan (theory only, driving only or full), pay via Orange Money or MTN MoMo. After confirmation, you receive a digital receipt and enrolment QR code.

faq.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
faq.answer: Orange Money and MTN Mobile Money for candidate subscriptions and driving school packages. Partner establishments can also pay their SaaS subscription by bank transfer.

faq.question: How does the Consort file work on CODAKIS?
faq.answer: From the app, track the 6 mandatory documents, receive deadline reminders and verify your file is complete before your administrative appointment.

howItWorks.metaDescription: Discover the candidate and driving school journey on CODAKIS.
howItWorks.title: How it works
intro: CODAKIS is the highway code learning platform and connection service with approved driving schools in Cameroon. Our goal is to support you from theory to the exam, through choosing your driving school and booking driving slots.

Whether you are a candidate wanting to revise theory, take mock exams or buy a driving plan, or a partner driving school manager, the journey is designed to be simple, transparent and adapted to the CEMAC context.
howItWorks.notice: YOUR BEST GUARANTEE IS TO GO THROUGH CODAKIS: NEVER PAY FOR A PLAN OFF-PLATFORM BEFORE VERIFYING THE APPROVED DRIVING SCHOOL.
howItWorks.highlightsNote: CODAKIS facilitates the licence journey between candidates and approved driving schools. Create your account, revise theory or submit your establishment file to appear in the geolocated directory.

clientFaq.question: How do I find an approved driving school near me?
clientFaq.answer: Create a candidate account, then browse the CODAKIS directory filtered by city or proximity. Each driving school displays its plans, pass rate and candidate reviews.

clientFaq.question: Is candidate registration free?
clientFaq.answer: Yes. You can create an account, access basic courses and take quizzes for free. Driving and complete plans are offered by partner driving schools.

clientFaq.question: Can I revise theory without enrolling at a driving school?
clientFaq.answer: Absolutely. CODAKIS offers a self-paced highway code learning path. Driving school enrolment is only required for practical training and the exam.

schoolFaq.question: How do I become a CODAKIS partner driving school?
schoolFaq.answer: Contact our team via the contact form or create a manager account. We verify your MINT approval before publishing your establishment in the directory.

schoolFaq.question: How are Mobile Money payments handled?
schoolFaq.answer: Candidates pay via MTN MoMo or Orange Money. CODAKIS secures the transaction and notifies your driving school once payment is confirmed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Thank you for visiting CODAKIS (hereinafter « we », « our » or « the platform »). This policy explains our practices regarding the collection, use and protection of personal data (« Data » or « Personal Information ») when you use our website, applications and services (collectively, the « Site »). CODAKIS is the data controller for your Data on the Site. By using the Site, you agree that your Information will be processed in accordance with this policy and our terms of use.
privacy.highlightsTitle: Key points of the privacy policy

highlights.title: Personal data we collect
highlights.body: When you create an account, use our services, browse the directory, subscribe or contact us, you voluntarily provide certain information: name, email address, phone number, city, Consort file documents, etc. See section 2 for details.

highlights.title: Tracking technologies
highlights.body: We may use cookies and similar technologies to measure audience, secure the Site and improve your experience. You can accept or refuse non-essential cookies via the banner shown on your first visit.

highlights.title: Use, retention and storage
highlights.body: We retain your Data for as long as necessary to provide the service, comply with legal obligations and resolve disputes.

highlights.title: Sharing information
highlights.body: Within legal limits, we may share your Information with technical providers, partner driving schools as part of enrolment, competent authorities or in case of corporate restructuring.

highlights.title: Your choices
highlights.body: You can manage communication preferences, object to certain processing, request access, rectification or deletion of your Data, and withdraw marketing consent at any time.

highlights.title: Access and modification
highlights.body: Registered users can modify their information from their candidate or driving school account, or by contacting us.

highlights.title: Policy updates
highlights.body: We may update this policy by publishing a new version on the Site. For significant changes, we may notify you by email when required by law.

highlights.title: EEA residents / GDPR
highlights.body: CODAKIS complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Data subjects may exercise their rights where applicable.

highlights.title: Contact
highlights.body: For any questions about this policy: contact@codakis.cm or via our Contact page.

fullSections.title: 1. Scope
paragraphs: CODAKIS is an online platform that supports driving licence candidates and connects them with approved driving schools in Cameroon. We provide services related to theory learning, driving school search, subscriptions and candidate and driving school account management.

fullSections.title: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: The Data collected depends on how you use the Site.

subsections.title: Registration, services and account
paragraphs: You can browse certain pages without creating an account. In that case, we may collect technical data (IP address, browser type, pages viewed, approximate geolocation data).

When you create a candidate or driving school account, you must provide certain information (valid email, identity, contact details, city, etc.). For purchases or subscriptions, billing information may be requested; payments are processed by external providers and we do not store full card details.

subsections.title: Responses to your requests
paragraphs: If you contact us (form, email, chat), we use the details provided to answer your questions and, where applicable, send service-related communications.

fullSections.title: 3. Use, retention and storage
paragraphs: We process your Data for the following purposes:

subsections.title: Site operation and service delivery
bullets: Respond to your requests and provide customer support.
Manage your account, subscriptions and licence journey.
Display approved driving schools in the directory.
Connect candidates and partner driving schools.
Personalise content and improve Site security.

fullSections.title: 8. Tracking technologies (cookies)
paragraphs: When you visit, we collect usage information sent by your device (pages viewed, clicks, session duration). We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the Site, measure audience and remember your preferences.
